headline: PropShare Celestia discloses 94.98% public shareholding for Q2FY27
hook: Public ownership nears 95% at PropShare Celestia
summary: PropShare Celestia has filed its shareholding pattern for the second quarter of the 2027 fiscal year. The data indicates that public shareholders hold a 94.98% stake in the company. This disclosure provides transparency regarding the current distribution of equity ownership.
why_it_matters: High public float levels can influence stock liquidity and volatility.
